title: Little Boy in Toy Wagon Outdoors, 1943 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A classic wartime 1943 black-and-white snapshot featuring a young blonde boy, identified on the back as Tony Knox, sitting thoughtfully inside a metal toy coaster wagon on a driveway. Surrounding him is a sunlit suburban neighborhood dotted with palm trees and detached garages, embodying mid-century American childhood during the World War II era. The photograph features decorative scalloped deckled edges.
